topic: Full Stack Integration: React, Node.js, Express, and Database
learningObjectives: Trace data flow between a React frontend, backend API, and database.
Connect frontend components to backend REST endpoints.
Design a complete full stack application architecture.

activities.title: Full Stack Architecture
activities.instruction: Build the architecture of a complete web application.

content.concept: A full stack application connects the frontend, backend API, business logic, and database into one system.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: End-to-End Data Flow
activities.instruction: Trace data from the UI to the database and back.

content.concept: User actions can trigger frontend requests, backend processing, database operations, and responses that update the interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Integration Sequence
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a full stack request.

content.concept: A typical request travels from the React UI through an API route and service layer to the database before returning a response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Full Stack Feature Builder
activities.instruction: Compose the frontend, API, logic, and data layers for a feature.

content.concept: A complete feature requires coordinated frontend components, API endpoints, backend logic, and persistent data models.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
